sources.table_name: Population Representation in the Military Services · FY 2014 · Table B-25, Active Component Commissioned Officer Gains and Corps
sources.definition: Black is the published race category, with Hispanic ethnicity tabulated separately. Men or women divided by all active-component commissioned officers in the Army, Navy, Marine Corps and Air Force at fiscal year-end. Reserve, warrant and Coast Guard officers are outside the denominator. The Army did not report a multiracial category.
sources.locator: Officer Corps panels (not Officer Gains), Total DoD number column. Use unadjusted Black rows for men/women and the combined corps total.
